出生地: 英国,英格兰,多塞特,伯恩茅斯
简介: Neil Linpow was born in Bournemouth, Dorset, England. Growing up he was a talented football player and held professional contracts at schoolboy level for a number of clubs, including AFC Bournemouth and Portsmouth FC. However, after a series of bad ankle injuries he chose to attend drama school and pursue a career in acting.
